title: Four windows pile up past their deadline and must fold into one edition

run.note: Do not run briefings until W4 is past its 10-minute grace deadline, then release them all at once (on QA: pause the feed's briefing job, or start the replay with --start four windows in the past).

notes: Each window has one distinct development. Expect W1 to W3 settled DEFERRED with SUPERSEDED_BY_LATER_WINDOW and their content published once in the W4 edition.

items.title: Minimum wage to rise to 720 calvers in January
items.body: PORT SELIN (CPA) - The monthly minimum wage will rise from 650 to 720 calvers on 1 January, Labour Minister Teo Marsh said on Monday after talks with unions and employers. Employers' groups had proposed 690 calvers.

items.title: Calvera exports fall 4 percent in third quarter
items.body: PORT SELIN (CPA) - Calvera's exports fell 4 percent in the third quarter compared with a year earlier, the statistics office said on Monday, mainly because of lower prices for copper and fish. Imports were flat.

items.title: Opposition files no-confidence motion over port contract
items.body: PORT SELIN (CPA) - The opposition Civic Alliance filed a no-confidence motion against Transport Minister Elian Sorr on Monday over a 90 million calver port dredging contract awarded without a tender. A vote must be held within ten days.

items.title: Kesh province declares end of flood emergency
items.body: PORT SELIN (CPA) - Kesh province ended its flood emergency on Monday after the Vell river fell back below warning level. Schools in Orlan and Mere will reopen on Wednesday.
